scenes.title: Corporate Rate Risk & Municipal Bankruptcy
scenes.purpose: Problem-first hook: Corporate interest rate risk and the Orange County municipal bankruptcy dilemma
takeaways: Treasurers face severe rate hike profit destruction
Orange County lost $1.6B from 7.4-year duration
FRAs and duration hedging provide institutional defense

beats.speaker: novice

en.display: Why do corporate treasurers panic when central banks raise interest rates, even when current cash balances look healthy? Can an unexpected rate hike wipe out years of corporate profit?

en.display: Consider Orange County in 1994. Treasurer Robert Citron ran a 20 billion dollar leveraged repo portfolio with securities averaging 7.4 years to payout. When the Federal Reserve raised benchmark interest rates by 300 basis points, the portfolio lost 1.6 billion dollars in months.

en.display: This catastrophic breakdown occurred because unhedged bond positions multiply rate hikes into massive capital losses. Simultaneously, corporations needing to borrow in six months face unpredictable financing costs without forward rate protection.

en.display: To solve these twin dilemmas, institutional finance invented Forward Rate Agreements to lock future borrowing costs and bond portfolio hedging. A Forward Rate Agreement is an over-the-counter contract where counterparties lock an interest rate over a future period.

scenes.title: Borrower Certainty vs Floating Return
scenes.purpose: Tension: Fixed rate borrowers seeking cost certainty versus floating rate market lenders
takeaways: Borrowers need guaranteed fixed borrowing costs
Commercial lenders demand floating market yields
FRAs reconcile conflict without exchanging principal

beats.speaker: narrator

en.display: Every interest rate transaction contains a natural tug of war between two opposing economic forces. On one side, corporate borrowers seek guaranteed borrowing costs to fund operations without fear of rising interest rates.
en.spoken: Every interest rate transaction contains a natural tug of war between two opposing economic forces. On one side, corporate borrowers seek guaranteed borrowing costs to fund operations without fear of rising interest rates.

hi.spoken: हर इंटरेस्ट रेट ट्रांजैक्शन में दो विरोधी ताकतों के बीच खिंचाव होता है। एक तरफ, कॉर्पोरेट बॉरोअर्स बढ़ती ब्याज दरों के डर के बिना अपने ऑपरेशंस चलाने के लिए गारंटीड बॉरोइंग कॉस्ट्स चाहते हैं।

en.display: On the opposing side, commercial lenders demand floating market returns to protect themselves from inflation. If interest rates climb, fixed loans trap lenders in below-market yields, while falling rates penalize borrowers.
en.spoken: On the opposing side, commercial lenders demand floating market returns to protect themselves from inflation. If interest rates climb, fixed loans trap lenders in below-market yields, while falling rates penalize borrowers.

scenes.title: Four Pillars of Term Structure & Duration
scenes.purpose: Roadmap: The Four Pillars of Forward Rates, Duration, Convexity, and Term Structure
takeaways: Pillar 1: FRAs lock rates with cash settlement
Pillar 2: Macaulay and Modified duration metrics
Pillars 3 & 4: Convexity and term structure

beats.speaker: narrator

en.display: Pillar 1 introduces Forward Rate Agreements, where counterparties lock future borrowing rates. Cash settlement means transferring only the net interest difference at settlement date rather than borrowing the full principal.
en.spoken: Pillar 1 introduces Forward Rate Agreements, where counterparties lock future borrowing rates. Cash settlement means transferring only the net interest difference at settlement date rather than borrowing the full principal.

en.display: Pillar 2 establishes Macaulay duration and Modified duration. Macaulay duration is the weighted average time until bond cash flows arrive. Modified duration means duration adjusted for compounding, measuring percentage price change per yield shift.
en.spoken: Pillar 2 establishes Macaulay duration and Modified duration. Macaulay duration is the weighted average time until bond cash flows arrive. Modified duration means duration adjusted for compounding, measuring percentage price change per yield shift.

hi.display: पिलर 2 मैकॉले ड्यूरेशन और मॉडिफाइड ड्यूरेशन स्थापित करता है। मैकॉले ड्यूरेशन बॉन्ड कैश फ्लोज़ मिलने का वेटेड एवरेज समय है। मॉडिफाइड ड्यूरेशन का अर्थ है यील्ड शिफ्ट पर पर्सेंटेज प्राइस चेंज मापने के लिए कंपाउंडिंग से एडजस्टेड ड्यूरेशन।

en.display: Pillar 3 develops convexity. Convexity captures the non-linear curvature in bond prices, refining linear duration estimates when market yields experience large unexpected shifts across the cycle.

en.display: Pillar 4 analyzes two major term structure theories. Expectations Theory states that long rates equal the average of expected future short rates. Liquidity Preference Theory states that forward rates exceed expected zero rates because lenders demand risk premiums.
en.spoken: Pillar 4 analyzes two major term structure theories. Expectations Theory states that long rates equal the average of expected future short rates. Liquidity Preference Theory states that forward rates exceed expected zero rates because lenders demand risk premiums.

data.title: Eight Core Principles of FRAs, Duration & Convexity

rules.title: Rule 1: FRA Borrowing Rate Lock
rules.text: A Forward Rate Agreement fixes borrowing rates on future principal without exchanging principal.

rules.title: Rule 2: In-Advance Settlement
rules.text: Cash settlement occurs at date T1 discounting net interest savings in advance.

rules.title: Rule 3: Macaulay Duration Fulcrum
rules.text: Macaulay duration measures the weighted average maturity of all bond cash flows.

rules.title: Rule 4: Modified Duration Sensitivity
rules.text: Modified duration scales percentage price moves directly against yield shocks.

rules.title: Rule 5: 50 bps Hike Calculation
rules.text: A 50 basis point yield hike on 5.0-year duration causes a 2.50% price decline.

rules.title: Rule 6: Convexity Curvature Cushion
rules.text: Positive convexity cushions bond price declines during large interest rate hikes.

rules.title: Rule 7: Futures Duration Hedging
rules.text: The futures hedge ratio N star balances portfolio duration against contract duration.

rules.title: Rule 8: Term Liquidity Premiums
rules.text: Liquidity Preference Theory explains upward yield curves via investor risk premiums.
